ELIGIBLE PLAYERS PLAY ON THE PLATFORM DURING THE PERIOD.
PLAYERS CAN EARN POINTS BY PLAYING ON THE PLATFORM.
THE MORE YOU PLAY, THE MORE POINTS YOU EARN, REGARDLESS OF WIN OR LOSE.
POINTS ARE UPDATED EVERY 5 MINUTES, AND THE RANKING IS UPDATED EVERY DAY.
AT THE END OF THE PERIOD, THE PLATFORM WILL SHOW THE RESULT, AND THE PLAYERS ON THE LIST CAN GET THE PRIZES.
